div.head: Iudex 2
div.ab: Sume gyltas beoð fram þam godan deman þurh riht to betanne, sume þurh mildheortnesse tó forgyfanne.
Quedam culpe reputantur a bonis iudicibus secundum rectum emendande, quedam per Dei misericordiam condonande.
The good judge corrects some faults in a strict manner; others [are corrected] with merciful forgiveness.
Einige Vergehen sind von dem guten Richter durch [strenges] Recht zur Ordnung zu bringen, einige aus Barmherzigkeit zu vergeben.
Some offences are to be set right by the good judge through [strict] law, some to be forgiven out of mercy.
